messages.author: Oscar Lindqvist
messages.text: Probably a dumb question: installs jump every Saturday/Sunday in the pacing sheet but spend doesn't move as much. Is something broken?

replies.author: Daniel Esposito
replies.text: Not broken. Casual games always see a weekend uplift, people have more time to play. CPIs are usually a little lower Sat/Sun.

replies.author: Ingrid Solberg
replies.text: +1. That's why we compare week over week (Mon-Sun to Mon-Sun) and never day vs previous day in the weekly report. Template is on Confluence: *Weekly UA Report Template*.
